extensionDescription.message: Stash tabs in one click, get them back any time. Local-first: no account, no server, no host permissions.

empty_hint.message: Click the ShiTab toolbar icon to save every web page in this window as a session.

group_locked_hint.message: Locked sessions can't be deleted, and their tabs can't be removed or moved.

group_empty.message: This session is empty. Drag a web page into it from another session.

confirm_delete_group_body.message: __count__ saved tabs will be removed. This cannot be undone.

result_skipped_note.message: __count__ were not opened on purpose (already open, or not restorable)

capture_no_tabs.message: This window has no stashable web pages.

import_invalid_json.message: That file is not valid JSON.

import_wrong_format.message: This is not a ShiTab backup (expected format "shitab-backup").

import_unsupported_version.message: Backup version __version__ is newer than this ShiTab supports (v1).

export_done.message: Backup written to your Downloads folder.

options_restore_hint.message: Which window gets the tabs is decided per session: the icon bar offers "restore here" and "restore in a new window".

options_language_note.message: Takes effect immediately, no reload needed. The brand word inside the pages follows this switch; the extension's name in edge://extensions and its store description still follow your browser language - that part is resolved by the browser, not by us.

options_permissions_body.message: Three permissions are requested at install: tabs (reads tab titles and URLs — without it nothing can be saved), storage (keeps your sessions in this browser) and alarms (gives the sync one heartbeat even when every page is closed). No host permission is requested at install, and adding a feature never disables the extension for existing users. Only when you turn on WebDAV sync and press Connect & sync does the browser ask you once for the single server address you typed — and only that address. It is never used to read the content of ordinary web pages. Your sessions are stored only in this browser’s local storage; there is no account and no server of ours.

bulk_delete_confirm.message: Delete __groups__ selected sessions and __records__ records? They go to the trash; locked ones are skipped.

category_empty_hint.message: Create a category, then drag a session onto it to group sessions by topic.

rail_resize_hint.message: Drag to resize, double-click to reset

capture_failed_kept_open.message: Stash failed — no tabs were closed.

result_no_landing.message: Kept the active tab: no landing page could be opened.

options_keep_active_tab.message: Keep the active tab open after stashing

options_include_pinned_tabs.message: Also stash tabs I pinned myself

options_pinned_entry_enabled.message: Keep a ShiTab tab pinned at the left of the tab bar

options_auto_restore_pinned_tab.message: Recreate it if I close it

options_keep_pinned_tab_first.message: Snap it back to the leftmost pinned slot

options_entry_hint.message: Corrections happen when the browser starts, when a window is opened, and right after a stash — not while you drag tabs around.

sync_connect_note.message: Fill in these three and connect. Your data stays on your own server.

sync_off_hint.message: Turning this off only stops uploading and downloading — the address, the saved password and your local sessions all stay, and remote history is never deleted on its own.

sync_step_once.message: One click does all of it: check the address → ask the browser for permission for this one origin → create the folders → push the first version.

sync_http_title.message: This is an http:// (plain text) address: tab titles and URLs can be read by anyone along the way.

sync_credential_hint.message: Nutstore needs an app password: generate one on its website under Account info → Security options → Add app password, and use your account email as the username. Both stay on this device.

options_sync_allow_insecure.message: Allow http:// (plain text) for this server

sync_permission_note.message: The browser permission requested here is used only to reach the WebDAV address you type above. It is not used to read the content of ordinary web pages.

sync_password_kept.message: Saved — leave blank to keep it

trash_empty.message: Deleted sessions stay here for 7 days, then disappear on their own.

bulk_check_row.message: Select every record in this session

trash_bulk_purge_confirm.message: Delete __groups__ sessions and __records__ records permanently? They cannot be recovered on this device.

conflict_hint.message: Another device deleted a session after you last synced, but this computer changed it afterwards. Pick which one wins — nothing is uploaded until you decide.

conflict_reason_consumed.message: consumed by a restore on the other device

conflict_reason_undone.message: removed by an undo on the other device

conflict_after_resolve.message: Keeping it means the session stays here and goes back to the server on the next sync. Confirming the deletion cannot be undone here once the recycle bin expires.

history_restored.message: Restored on this computer. The next sync uploads it as a new version — nothing on the server was overwritten or deleted.

history_prune_confirm.message: I understand that the deleted versions cannot be recovered

history_err_disabled.message: WebDAV sync is off, so there is nothing to read.

history_err_no_credential.message: No password is saved for this server.

history_err_no_manifest.message: The server has no ShiTab history yet. Sync once to create the first snapshot.

history_err_not_confirmed.message: Tick the confirmation first — this step deletes files on your server.

history_err_snapshot_failed.message: Could not write a local recoverable snapshot, so nothing on the server was deleted.

history_err_nothing_to_prune.message: Nothing to delete — the server already holds no more than what you want to keep.

history_err_not_found.message: That version is no longer on the server.

history_err_corrupt.message: That version's contents do not match its checksum, so it was not restored.

sync_notice_test_ok.message: Connection OK. The server answered and your address is reachable.

sync_notice_test_failed.message: Connection failed. The reason is in the sync status line below.

sync_notice_saved.message: Saved. Nothing has been uploaded yet - press Sync now when you want to.

sync_notice_pushed.message: Uploaded a new version to your server.

sync_notice_nothing.message: Nothing to upload - your server already holds exactly this content.

sync_notice_suspicious.message: Unusual change detected: this version has only __sessions__ sessions and __records__ records, while your server has __remoteSessions__ sessions and __remoteRecords__ records. That is too large a drop, so this version was not uploaded and nothing on your server changed. Check the recycle bin before you decide.

sync_notice_conflict.message: A conflict needs your choice above before anything is uploaded.

sync_notice_failed.message: Sync failed. Your local sessions were not modified.

sync_notice_connected_failed.message: Connected — but this sync did not finish. The address and permission are fine; the server side failed.

sync_notice_paused.message: Sync is off. Nothing was deleted — on your machine or on the server.

sync_notice_skipped.message: No check this time — it isn't due yet.

sync_notice_in_flight.message: A sync is already running, so this request joined it.

sync_err_insecure.message: This address is plain http. Tick the box below first if you really mean it.

sync_err_need_password.message: Enter the password once - none is saved yet.

sync_err_permission_denied.message: The browser permission was not granted, so nothing was saved.

sync_err_bad_url.message: That WebDAV address is not valid. Include https:// at the front.

sync_err_generic.message: Could not save. Check the address, username and password.

sync_hint_enable_first.message: Tick the switch above first - sync is currently off, so the buttons below do nothing.

options_general_sub.message: How stashing and the entry tab behave. Changes apply right away — there is no save button.

options_data_sub.message: Sessions live only in this browser’s local storage. The export is a single JSON file — use it to move or back them up.

options_about_sub.message: What this extension is, what it can touch, and how to support it.

options_keep_active_tab_hint.message: Keeps the page you are looking at and closes the rest.

options_dependency_hint.message: Turn the option above on first — this one does nothing without it.

options_import_append_hint.message: Import only appends. It never overwrites existing sessions.

options_trash_hint.message: Deleted sessions go to the workbench trash first — the row at the bottom of the left rail, above theme and settings. Recoverable records stay on this machine for __days__ days.

options_official_hint.message: New versions, guides and new features go out first on the official account 师兄知道. Scan the code, or search that name in WeChat.

options_sponsor_note.message: Every feature is free and open source forever. Sponsoring unlocks nothing and changes nothing — it just makes the next release come sooner.

options_qr_alt_official.message: QR code for the 师兄知道 official account

options_subtitle.message: Stash tabs in one click, get them back any time

options_sync_sub.message: Sync your sessions to your own WebDAV drive. Off by default: until you fill this in, no request is ever sent.

options_repo_hint.message: The source lives here — please file issues on Gitee.
